latestVersion.changelog:
Vozo AI — Initial Release

- Cloud-based tool for editing and enhancing voiceovers in video clips.
- Supports upload of MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM files up to 500MB with 1080p MP4 output.
- Easy onboarding with automatic session setup and free token provision (100 credits, 7-day expiry).
- Actions for upload, credit check, export, and session state accessible via simple commands and keyword detection.
- Fast cloud rendering pipeline; most edits complete in 30–90 seconds.
- Includes timeline summary, error handling, and support for multiple media formats.
